parsed.summary: The patch changes the behavior of path reporting in pytest, which could have unintended consequences.

issues.description: The patch sets abspath to True unconditionally, which may break existing behavior where relative paths are desired.
The patch does not include any tests to verify the new behavior or ensure it does not regress other cases.
